content.text: UP/DOWN move   Enter restart   B back

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.gridW = 20
v.gridH = 13
v.paddle1Y = 6
v.paddle2Y = 6
v.paddleH = 3
v.ballX = 10.0
v.ballY = 6.0
v.ballVX = 10.0
v.ballVY = 6.0
v.score1 = v.score1 or 0
v.score2 = v.score2 or 0
v.inputY = 0
v.boardText = ""
scripts.update:
local v = ctx.v
local dt = time.dt

-- player movement
if v.inputY ~= 0 then
    v.paddle1Y = v.paddle1Y + v.inputY * 15.0 * dt
    v.inputY = 0
end
v.paddle1Y = math.max(0, math.min(v.gridH - v.paddleH, v.paddle1Y))

-- AI movement
local center2 = v.paddle2Y + v.paddleH / 2
if center2 < v.ballY - 0.5 then
    v.paddle2Y = v.paddle2Y + 8.0 * dt
elseif center2 > v.ballY + 0.5 then
    v.paddle2Y = v.paddle2Y - 8.0 * dt
end
v.paddle2Y = math.max(0, math.min(v.gridH - v.paddleH, v.paddle2Y))

-- ball movement
v.ballX = v.ballX + v.ballVX * dt
v.ballY = v.ballY + v.ballVY * dt

-- top/bottom bounce
if v.ballY <= 0 then
    v.ballY = 0
    v.ballVY = -v.ballVY
elseif v.ballY >= v.gridH - 1 then
    v.ballY = v.gridH - 1
    v.ballVY = -v.ballVY
end

-- paddle 1 collision
if v.ballX <= 1 and v.ballX >= 0 and v.ballVX < 0 then
    if v.ballY >= v.paddle1Y and v.ballY <= v.paddle1Y + v.paddleH then
        v.ballX = 1
        v.ballVX = -v.ballVX * 1.1
        v.ballVY = v.ballVY + (v.ballY - (v.paddle1Y + v.paddleH/2)) * 2
    end
end

-- paddle 2 collision
if v.ballX >= v.gridW - 2 and v.ballX <= v.gridW - 1 and v.ballVX > 0 then
    if v.ballY >= v.paddle2Y and v.ballY <= v.paddle2Y + v.paddleH then
        v.ballX = v.gridW - 2
        v.ballVX = -v.ballVX * 1.1
        v.ballVY = v.ballVY + (v.ballY - (v.paddle2Y + v.paddleH/2)) * 2
    end
end

-- scoring
if v.ballX < 0 then
    v.score2 = v.score2 + 1
    v.ballX = 10.0
    v.ballY = 6.0
    v.ballVX = 10.0
    v.ballVY = 6.0
elseif v.ballX >= v.gridW then
    v.score1 = v.score1 + 1
    v.ballX = 10.0
    v.ballY = 6.0
    v.ballVX = -10.0
    v.ballVY = 6.0
end

-- render to text
local text = ""
local bx = math.floor(v.ballX)
local by = math.floor(v.ballY)
local p1y = math.floor(v.paddle1Y)
local p2y = math.floor(v.paddle2Y)
for y = 0, v.gridH - 1 do
    for x = 0, v.gridW - 1 do
        if x == 0 and y >= p1y and y < p1y + v.paddleH then
            text = text .. "]"
        elseif x == v.gridW - 1 and y >= p2y and y < p2y + v.paddleH then
            text = text .. "["
        elseif x == bx and y == by then
            text = text .. "O"
        else
            text = text .. "."
        end
    end
    text = text .. "\n"
end
v.boardText = text
